principles.reason: Wealth should not determine pretrial liberty for otherwise similarly situated defendants.
Unconvicted people retain liberty unless individualized legal grounds justify detention.
Detention disrupts work and family opportunities, especially for people unable to pay.
Avoid unnecessary incarceration expense; this is an authored argument, not a measured savings rate.
A person may oppose release reforms perceived to weaken appearance or safety safeguards; actual individualized safeguards matter.
Eliminating commercial money bail displaces surety-bail providers.
